text:
sam: Planning a maintenance window -> rack-level powercycle + kernel softpatch in ap-south on Mon 2025-04-14 01:00-03:00 UTC. We'll do staggered reboots across 3 racks to avoid big capacity cliffs.
anika: Key ask: keep reserved/dedicated customers off the affected racks. Can we pre-pin them to ap-south-dedicated-standby?
mohit: Yes, we can emergency-pin legacy-dedicated to standby. That reduces available spare; we'll need to pre-warm 8 extra nodes in ap-shadow for 90m.
riley: Networking note: toggle interface flap dampening on ToRs to limit ARP storms during reboots. Also prep BGP community to failover to secondary egress if packet loss >1%.
sam: Sequence: 1) bump shadow reserve; 2) flip BGP prep; 3) cohort cordon/drain/reboot; 4) kvseed + warm caches; 5) demote reserve. Abort if p95 >220ms for 10m or eviction >5%.
mohit: Canary plan: start with one low-traffic internal tenant + two external canaries. SRE oncall (anika) will validate after each cohort. If any cohort shows OOM or kernel warnings, abort and rollback.
anika: Cost forecast: 8 nodes * 1.5h + 45m burst ~ $680. Finance needs ticket if >$750. @opsbot please open FIN request.
opsbot: Created MAINT-7788 and FIN-3112. Notified finance@redwood and oncall@eng-sre.
riley: Smart-routing tweak: for the window, if queue latency >140ms for AP origins, route to eu-west pools for best-effort. We should log route-fallback events for postmortem.
mohit: We'll also increase KV cache TTL temporarily to reduce regeneration load. Plan to run a small kvseed job after each rack returns.
san: Typo: sam: Communications: I'll send a short customer note to reserved/dedicated tenants and post status page update. Template: "Planned maintenance Apr 14 01:00-03:00 UTC; short evictions/latency; no data impact."
anika: Final readiness check T-60. If green, start at 01:00 UTC. I'll watch cohort-1 and post health summary every 10m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
